summary_1line: After Indrajit’s death, Ravana collapses in grief, rages against fate, and in fury resolves to kill Sita before being restrained.

image_candidates.scene_text: Ravana collapses in his palace after hearing the news of Indrajit’s death, courtiers standing frozen around the fallen king.
With eyes blazing and tears falling like boiling oil, Ravana grips a shining sword and storms toward the Ashoka grove.
Sita in the Ashoka grove recoils in terror as Ravana approaches with an upraised sword while demonesses look on.
